ruleDefinitions.name: Recon Information for Export with Command Prompt
ruleDefinitions.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\tree\\\.com$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WMIC\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\doskey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "wmic\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "DOSKEY\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "sc\.exe")) AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ \\%TEMP\\%\\\\.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ \\%TMP\\%\\\\.*")))
